The console has a vertical design with a slim profile and a visible disc drive.
The controller is wrapped in clear plastic packaging.
A USB cable is visible in both photos.

photo 0 and photo 1 show the PS4 Slim logo on the console.
The photos do not show the console powered on or connected to a screen.
photo 0 and photo 1 show the retail box for a DualShock 4 controller.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The controller may have a dead battery or stick drift.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or a game.

Video of the controller being used to play a game.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
